शारवरी का यह इमोशनल अंदाज आपका दिल जीत लेगा! 💖

एक्ट्रेस शारवरी अपनी आने वाली फिल्म Yeh Prem Mol Liya के प्रमोशन के दौरान अपनी मां की दी हुई पुरानी गुलाबी पटोला साड़ी में नजर आईं। 🌸

इंस्टाग्राम पर फोटो शेयर करते हुए एक्ट्रेस ने बताया कि जब उनकी मां ने पहली बार 'Jhumka Patola' गाना देखा था, तो उन्होंने प्यार और आशीर्वाद के तौर पर यह कीमती साड़ी उन्हें गिफ्ट की थी। ✨

शारवरी के मुताबिक, इस साड़ी को नया लुक देने से पहले उन्होंने अपनी मां की पुरानी तस्वीरें देखीं। एक्ट्रेस ने लिखा कि मां की साड़ी पहनना उनके प्यार और आशीर्वाद में लिपटे रहने जैसा महसूस होता है। 🥰

Sooraj Barjatya के डायरेक्शन में बन रही इस फिल्म में शारवरी के साथ Ayushmann Khurrana हैं, और यह 27 November 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगी। 🎬

क्या आप भी अपनी मां के ट्रेडिशनल कपड़े री-स्टाइल करना पसंद करते हैं? हमें कमेंट्स में बताएं! 🤔

ctx.text:
The actress revisits a treasured family heirloom gifted by her mother after watching ‘Jhumka Patola’, giving the traditional saree a fresh interpretation.
Actress Sharvari has added a personal touch to her promotional wardrobe for Yeh Prem Mol Liya by reimagining her mother’s treasured pink Patola saree. Sharing pictures of the look on social media, the actress revealed the emotional story behind the heirloom, describing it as a symbol of her mother’s love, pride and blessings.
The saree holds a special place in Sharvari’s family, having been worn by her mother over the years and associated with several cherished memories. According to the actress, her mother gifted it to her after watching her song ‘Jhumka Patola’ for the first time. The gesture made the outfit particularly meaningful, turning it into more than just another look for a promotional appearance.
Sharvari chose to give the traditional garment a fresh interpretation while retaining its sentimental value. The process also involved looking through old photographs of her mother wearing the saree, allowing the actress to revisit the memories attached to it before presenting the reimagined look.
Sharing the story behind the outfit on Instagram, Sharvari wrote, “When my Aai watched #JhumkaPatola for the first time, I will never forget the love and pride in her eyes. She gave me her beautiful pink Patola saree as a blessing! An heirloom she has adorned over the years and made so many beautiful memories in. Reinventing something so precious to her and wearing it for promotions has been such a special feeling. Going through old pictures of her wearing it and then seeing her reaction to what we created was just priceless. Wearing her saree feels like being wrapped in her love and blessings!”
The look reflects a personal approach to fashion, with Sharvari choosing to incorporate a family heirloom into her public appearances rather than opting for an entirely new ensemble. By reworking a garment connected to her mother’s memories, the actress has also highlighted how traditional clothing can carry emotional significance across generations.
Sharvari is currently promoting Yeh Prem Mol Liya , in which she stars opposite Ayushmann Khurrana. Directed by Sooraj Barjatya, the musical romantic family drama marks another Rajshri Productions venture centred on relationships and family values.
Yeh Prem Mol Liya is scheduled to release in cinemas on November 27, 2026.
